Class HashTable<K,V>

java.lang.Object
HashTable<K,V>
Type Parameters:
K - the key type
V - the value type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<Map.Entry<K,V>>
public final class HashTable<K,V> extends Object implements Iterable<Map.Entry<K,V>>
A resizable hash table that stores key-value pairs and resolves collisions with chains.
